continuous_text.title: It's My Party!
continuous_text.content:
Welcome, friends.
Please sit down.
It's time for my party!
With games and a clown!

I have pizza, chicken,
Salad, too.
Fruit, cake,
And ice cream for you!

Or put some pasta
On your plate.
With juice or milk
It sure tastes great.

Thanks for the presents.
What a great day!
Let's eat and drink
And play, play, play. (x2)

continuous_text.title: How Many More Days?
continuous_text.content:
Frame 1:
Tim: What day is it today?
Tim: It's Friday. My party is on Saturday. Only one more day!
Frame 2:
Tim: Today is Saturday. It's my party!
Frame 3:
Tim: Mmm! I have pizza! What do you have?
Jane: I have chicken and salad.
Frame 4:
Jane: What does Maria have?
Maria: She has pasta.
Frame 5:
Jane: What does Patrick have?
Tim: I don't know. Patrick?
Frame 6:
Jane: Oh, no! He has cake and ice cream!
Tim: Patrick!
continuous_text.notes: Frames 1-4 on p. 120; frames 5-6 on p. 121; track 189

continuous_text.title: Content Connection: Sweet and Salty Food
continuous_text.content:
1 Food can be sweet or salty. Sweet food has sugar. Chocolate and cookies are sweet. Cake is sweet, too. They have sugar in them. My favorite sweet food is chocolate.
2 Chips have salt. Pizza and fries have salt, too. They're all salty. My favorite salty food is pizza.

continuous_text.title: Culture Connection: Birthday Food
continuous_text.content:
1 My name's Miguel. In Mexico, I have a piñata with candy on my birthday. It's my favorite day.
2 I'm Jack. I live in the United States. I have a big cake on my birthday. It's very sweet.
3 I'm Susie from South Korea. I have seaweed soup on my birthday. It's salty.
4 I'm Anya. I'm from Russia. On my birthday, I have a big fruit pie. It's my favorite sweet cake.

curriculum_components.title: Party Time
curriculum_components.description: Vocabulary presentation for 11 common party food and drink items.

curriculum_components.title: It's My Party!
curriculum_components.description: Rhythmic song reviewing party foods, drinks, and social phrases.

curriculum_components.title: How Many More Days?
curriculum_components.description: Comic narrative introducing days of the week and party food sharing.

curriculum_components.title: What do you have? / What does she have?
curriculum_components.description: Present simple questions and answers with 'have/has' for food possessions.

curriculum_components.title: Sweet and salty food
curriculum_components.description: Scientific classification of foods by taste categories (sweet, salty) and ingredients (sugar, salt).

curriculum_components.title: Sweet and Salty Food poster
curriculum_components.description: Creating and presenting a poster categorizing sweet and salty items.

curriculum_components.title: Negative Present Simple (don't / doesn't)
curriculum_components.description: Negative present simple forms across person subjects.

curriculum_components.title: Birthday Food
curriculum_components.description: Cross-cultural birthday food customs in Mexico, the USA, South Korea, and Russia.

curriculum_components.title: Eat three meals a day.
curriculum_components.description: Nutritional and daily routine habits: breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

curriculum_components.title: l, ll, v, w
curriculum_components.description: Letter-sound correspondences and sound blending for /l/ (l, ll), /v/, and /w/.

curriculum_components.title: Review
curriculum_components.description: Review and self-assessment of food, negative verbs, and tastes.
